headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 31, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox dominated the Detroit Tigers 7-1, with Edgar Quero leading the Tigers' offense with 2 hits, including a home run. Grant Taylor impressed on the mound with 2 scoreless innings.

Injuries and availability continue to impact teams, with Angel Zerpa being transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to left forearm tightness for the Milwaukee Brewers. Craig Kimbrel has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 28, 2026, with a right wrist strain for the Tampa Bay Rays.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place, including the Toronto Blue Jays acquiring right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold from the Detroit Tigers in exchange for left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez. The Washington Nationals acquired left-handed pitcher Carson Palmquist from the Colorado Rockies for cash, while the Cincinnati Reds traded right-handed pitcher Zach McCambley to the Miami Marlins for right fielder Rece Hinds.

top_news.title: **White Sox Rout Tigers 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox dominated the Detroit Tigers, winning 7-1 behind a strong team effort. Edgar Quero led the Tigers' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Grant Taylor impressed on the mound with 2 scoreless innings.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall to Nationals in 9-4 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 9-4 victory over the San Diego Padres, ending their opponent's winning streak. Manny Machado led the Padres' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall Short in Texas**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals dropped a 7-6 decision to the Texas Rangers, coming up just one run short. Carter Jensen led the Royals' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Orioles Edge Blue Jays in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 6-5 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Albert Suárez earning the win. Brandon Young led the Orioles' pitching staff with 6.2 innings pitched, 7 strikeouts, and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Brewers Update Angel Zerpa's Injury Status**
top_news.summary: Milwaukee Brewers left-handed pitcher Angel Zerpa has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to left forearm tightness. The move is a status change for the Brewers' player.

top_news.title: **Seabold Heads North in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays acquired right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold from the Detroit Tigers on May 27, 2026, in exchange for left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez.
